agent.command: We are recording a screencast of a two-pane workflow: an agent dispatches a job and a companion process watches it by ID. You MUST use the Bash tool to dispatch the job — do NOT type the job id yourself. A hook captures the Bash tool's stdout and a watcher keys off it, and the job id is generated at RUNTIME, so you cannot know it without actually running the command. Use the Bash tool to run exactly: bash -c 'printf "Dispatching job to worker pool...\n"; printf "JOB_ID=deploy-job-%s\n" "$RANDOM"'. After the Bash tool returns, reply with exactly one line: AGT-DISPATCHED-P9F. Do not skip the Bash call. Do not run any other tool.
